snippet.title: Pokémon TCG Pocket: Paldean Wonders | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Join Sprigatito, Fuecoco, and Quaxly as they join the world of Pokémon TCG Pocket! 🍃 🔥 💧

Explore all this new set has to offer, along with the Paldean Wonders of this beautiful region. Available February 25!

Find all your favorite Pokémon merchandise at the official Pokémon Center: https://www.pokemoncenter.com/
